novel_features.name: Schema snapshot & history
novel_features.description: Save a point-in-time copy of every collection's config to the local store, then browse history over time.
novel_features.rationale: Weaviate has no config versioning; only a local store can retain point-in-time collection configs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before any risky schema change so you have a rollback reference.

novel_features.name: Schema drift diff
novel_features.description: Diff a collection's live config against a saved snapshot or another collection.
novel_features.rationale: Requires two configs held locally to diff; the API has no diff endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Catch unintended config drift between environments or over time.

novel_features.name: Collection config lint
novel_features.description: Flag risky collection configs: no vectorizer set, replication factor of 1, unindexed high-cardinality properties.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local rule engine over the fetched config; no such endpoint exists.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Catch production-readiness gaps before they bite in an incident.

novel_features.name: Cross-collection tenant audit
novel_features.description: See tenant counts and activity status across every collection in one view.
novel_features.rationale: Requires fan-out across every collection's tenants; no bulk endpoint exists.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Spot inactive or overloaded tenants across a multi-tenant deployment at a glance.

novel_features.name: Schema export/import bundle
novel_features.description: Export every collection's config as one portable JSON bundle for backup or promotion to another environment.
novel_features.rationale: No native schema-only backup feature exists; only a local export/import loop can move collection configs between clusters.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Promote a schema from staging to production, or restore after an incident, without full data backup.

narrative.headline: Full collection-config control for Weaviate Cloud, plus schema history, drift diffing, and lint that no other Weaviate tool has.
narrative.value_prop: Manage every aspect of Weaviate collections — vectorizers, replication, sharding, multi-tenancy, and property indexes — from the command line. Unlike the official weaviate-cli or community tools, this CLI keeps a local history of your collection configs so you can diff, lint, and roll back with confidence.

quickstart.comment: Verify config and connectivity without making a live call
See every collection in your cluster
Save a local snapshot before making changes
Check for risky config before shipping

troubleshoots.fix: Set WEAVIATE_API_KEY to your Weaviate Cloud API key (Bearer token).

troubleshoots.symptom: Empty collections list on a real cluster
troubleshoots.fix: Run 'weaviate-collections-pp-cli sync' to refresh the local store from the live API.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to create, inspect, and tune Weaviate Cloud collections — vectorizer/replication/sharding/multi-tenancy config, property indexes, and shard management — and to track how collection configs change over time.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for inserting, querying, or searching data objects — it only manages collection (schema) config, not object data.
Do not use this CLI for self-hosted Weaviate cluster administration (nodes, backups, RBAC) — it targets the schema surface only.

recipes.title: Snapshot before a risky change
recipes.command: weaviate-collections-pp-cli schema snapshot --label pre-change && weaviate-collections-pp-cli schema objects-update Article --replication-config-factor 3
recipes.explanation: Save a rollback reference, then apply the change.

recipes.title: Diff a select subset of a large collection config
recipes.explanation: Pull only the fields that matter instead of the full nested config blob.
